text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
At that moment, Digi-tan realized— Only by 
competing in the Mile CS on both turf and 
dirt can one become a true all-rounder.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
“And so, here we are in Morioka! You could 
say we've traveled 'miles' for the Mile! 
Get it? Miles!!”

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Never in a million years did I expect to 
run into Yukino-san here?! After gettin' 
such precious encouragement, I gotta show 
her my coolest side, no matter what~!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Will Digi-tan seize victory and achieve 
Perfect Communication with the local 
girls!? —Find out next time☆
